verdict.rationale: CSC has a dedicated annual report filing service page. It sends a 45-day advance report of upcoming filings with good standing status, then CSC files and uploads the filed evidence to CSCNavigator. Status is tracked in real time on the Compliance Calendar. Together this describes a managed filing service run by the provider. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that CSC prepares the report content (not just files it), clarity on how it is packaged or priced as an add-on, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
